Players Committee card image of [[Mara Jade With Lightsaber]] (original printing), game text: “While Luke or Emperor on table, power +1 and she moves for free. Permanent weapon is •Mara Jade's Lightsaber (may target a character or creature for free; draw two destiny; target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if total destiny > defense value).”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/large/marajadewithlightsaber.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
